libs.note: BH-3559. Own-account pins (BH-1657): when a pinned project's claude rung cannot resolve a token on a box (no accounts.d/<label>.env, and the live token's fp label is neither the pin nor an alias of it in catalog/account-aliases.json), agent-call.sh and bin/account-pin-probe.sh raise ONE warn lane-alert per box+project per window, id account-pin-<box>-<project>, resolved on the first pinned call that works again. Applied by agent-call.sh and account-pin-probe.sh through lib_env_apply project-account.

knobs.note: How long one pinned_unavailable alert covers a box+project before the next refusal alerts again. Read as ${ACCOUNT_PIN_ALERT_WINDOW_S:-21600}; a value that is not a number falls back to 21600. Settings key lib.project-account.account_pin_alert_window_s.
